SELECT *, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),ord_input,120) AS ord_input_view, CONCAT(PROD_PG,' ',PROD_PG1,' ~ ') AS prod_pg, CONCAT(PROD_GD3,' ',PROD_GD4,' ~ ',PROD_GD5) AS prod_gd, CASE WHEN ILBO_GUBN = 'J' THEN '단취' WHEN ILBO_GUBN = 'A' THEN '열처리' WHEN ILBO_GUBN = 'R' THEN '템퍼링' ELSE '' END AS ilbo_gubn FROM WORKILBO LEFT OUTER JOIN ORDERT ON WORKILBO.ORD_CODE = ORDERT.ORD_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN PRODUCT ON ORDERT.PROD_CODE = PRODUCT.PROD_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN CORP ON PRODUCT.CORP_CODE = CORP.CORP_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN FACILITY ON WORKILBO.FAC_CODE = FACILITY.FAC_CODE WHERE 1=1
AND WORKILBO.ILBO_STRT >= CONCAT(#{sdate},' 00:00:00') AND WORKILBO.ILBO_STRT <= CONCAT(#{edate},' 23:59:59')
AND CORP.CORP_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',#{corp_name},'%')
AND PRODUCT.PROD_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',#{prod_name},'%')
AND PRODUCT.PROD_NO LIKE CONCAT('%',#{prod_no},'%')

SELECT *, (ORD_SU - ISNULL(danch_su,0)) AS danch_remain_su, CONCAT(PROD_PG,' ',PROD_PG1,' ~ ') AS prod_pg, CONCAT(PROD_GD3,' ',PROD_GD4,' ~ ',PROD_GD5) AS prod_gd, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),ord_input,120) AS ord_input_view, CASE WHEN WSTD_T43 IS NULL THEN '0' ELSE WSTD_T43 END AS wstd_t43 FROM ORDERT A LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT ord_code, SUM(ilbo_su) AS danch_su FROM WORKILBO WHERE ilbo_gubn = 'J' GROUP BY ord_code ) B ON A.ord_code = B.ord_code LEFT OUTER JOIN PRODUCT C ON A.prod_code = C.prod_code LEFT OUTER JOIN CORP D ON C.corp_code = D.corp_code LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT PROD_CODE, MAX(REPLACE((CASE WHEN WSTD_T43 IS NULL OR WSTD_T43 = '' THEN '0' ELSE WSTD_T43 END),',','')) AS WSTD_T43, MAX(wstd_t32) AS WSTD_T32, MAX(wstd_t33) AS WSTD_T33, MAX(wstd_t41) AS WSTD_T41, MAX(wstd_t87) AS WSTD_T87, MAX(wstd_t44) AS WSTD_T44, MAX(wstd_t51) AS WSTD_T51, MAX(wstd_t52) AS WSTD_T52, MAX(wstd_t53) AS WSTD_T53, MAX(wstd_t54) AS WSTD_T54, MAX(wstd_t30) AS WSTD_T30 FROM WORKSTD GROUP BY PROD_CODE ) E ON C.prod_code = E.prod_code WHERE (A.ord_su > B.danch_su OR B.danch_su IS NULL) AND A.ord_input >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
AND D.corp_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{corp_name},'%')
AND C.prod_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{prod_name},'%')
AND C.prod_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{prod_no},'%')
AND A.ord_code NOT IN
#{ord_code}
ORDER BY A.ord_code
